entries.name: Fighter (human)
entries.subject: a broad-shouldered human man in his thirties with a short dark beard, chain mail and a steel-rimmed shield. A fighter — The master of weapons and armor — steady, durable, relentless.

entries.name: Fighter (dwarf)
entries.subject: a stout dwarf woman with braided copper hair and a battle-scarred breastplate. A fighter — The master of weapons and armor — steady, durable, relentless.

entries.name: Fighter (orc)
entries.subject: a tall grey-green orc woman with tusks, a shaved head and heavy plate pauldrons. A fighter — The master of weapons and armor — steady, durable, relentless.

entries.name: Fighter (goliath)
entries.subject: a towering goliath man with stone-grey skin and tribal markings, holding a greatsword. A fighter — The master of weapons and armor — steady, durable, relentless.

entries.name: Cleric (dwarf)
entries.subject: a dwarf woman priestess with silver-streaked braids, a sun-disc holy symbol and a mace. A cleric — A conduit of divine light: heals, shields, and burns the undead.

entries.name: Cleric (human)
entries.subject: an elderly human man with kind eyes, white robes over scale mail and a glowing holy symbol. A cleric — A conduit of divine light: heals, shields, and burns the undead.

entries.name: Cleric (dragonborn)
entries.subject: a bronze-scaled dragonborn woman in vestments with a radiant halo of light. A cleric — A conduit of divine light: heals, shields, and burns the undead.

entries.name: Cleric (halfling)
entries.subject: a cheerful halfling man with curly hair, a too-large shield and a lantern of holy light. A cleric — A conduit of divine light: heals, shields, and burns the undead.

entries.name: Rogue (halfling)
entries.subject: a sly halfling with a crooked grin, a dark hood and a dagger twirling between fingers. A rogue — A knife in the dark who loves a loaded die.

entries.name: Rogue (elf)
entries.subject: a sharp-featured elf woman with a cowl, a mask over her lower face and twin shortswords. A rogue — A knife in the dark who loves a loaded die.

entries.name: Rogue (tiefling)
entries.subject: a purple-skinned tiefling man with curled horns, a feathered hat and loaded dice. A rogue — A knife in the dark who loves a loaded die.

entries.name: Rogue (human)
entries.subject: a young human woman with freckles, a patched leather coat and a lockpick behind her ear. A rogue — A knife in the dark who loves a loaded die.

entries.name: Barbarian (goliath)
entries.subject: a massive goliath woman with stone-grey skin, war paint and a greataxe. A barbarian — A storm of fury that shrugs off blows and hits like a landslide.

entries.name: Barbarian (human)
entries.subject: a wild-haired human man with a bear-pelt cloak, scars and a roaring expression. A barbarian — A storm of fury that shrugs off blows and hits like a landslide.

entries.name: Barbarian (orc)
entries.subject: a scarred orc man with tusks, braids and blood-red war paint. A barbarian — A storm of fury that shrugs off blows and hits like a landslide.

entries.name: Barbarian (dwarf)
entries.subject: a dwarf berserker with a flame-red beard, one hand wrapped firmly around the haft of a single raised handaxe, a second handaxe hanging from his belt. A barbarian — A storm of fury that shrugs off blows and hits like a landslide.

entries.name: Bard (elf)
entries.subject: a graceful elf man with long silver hair, a lute and an embroidered violet coat. A bard — Words and music shape the dice — a bard turns luck into a party resource.

entries.name: Bard (tiefling)
entries.subject: a crimson-skinned tiefling woman with ram horns, a feathered cap and a fiddle. A bard — Words and music shape the dice — a bard turns luck into a party resource.

entries.name: Bard (gnome)
entries.subject: a tiny gnome with wild teal hair, round spectacles and a set of pan-pipes. A bard — Words and music shape the dice — a bard turns luck into a party resource.

entries.name: Bard (human)
entries.subject: a charming human woman with a grin, a cloak of patchwork and a hand drum. A bard — Words and music shape the dice — a bard turns luck into a party resource.

entries.name: Druid (elf)
entries.subject: a wood elf woman with a crown of antlers and leaves, holding a gnarled staff. A druid — Shapeshifter and storm-caller, rooted in the old magic of living things.

entries.name: Druid (human)
entries.subject: a weathered human man with moss in his beard and a staff topped with a crow skull. A druid — Shapeshifter and storm-caller, rooted in the old magic of living things.

entries.name: Druid (halfling)
entries.subject: a halfling woman with mushrooms woven into her hair and a fox companion on her shoulder. A druid — Shapeshifter and storm-caller, rooted in the old magic of living things.

entries.name: Druid (orc)
entries.subject: an orc druid with bark-like tattoos and a cloak of living vines. A druid — Shapeshifter and storm-caller, rooted in the old magic of living things.

entries.name: Monk (human)
entries.subject: a shaven-headed human woman in storm-blue wraps, hands wrapped, in a fighting stance. A monk — A blur of fists and focus who plays more hands than anyone.

entries.name: Monk (elf)
entries.subject: a serene elf man with a long braid and simple robes, crackling with blue ki energy. A monk — A blur of fists and focus who plays more hands than anyone.

entries.name: Monk (dragonborn)
entries.subject: a sapphire-scaled dragonborn monk with prayer beads and wrapped fists. A monk — A blur of fists and focus who plays more hands than anyone.

entries.name: Monk (gnome)
entries.subject: a wiry old gnome master with a long white moustache and a bo staff. A monk — A blur of fists and focus who plays more hands than anyone.

entries.name: Paladin (human)
entries.subject: a noble human woman in polished plate with a sunburst tabard and a longsword. A paladin — An oath made steel — smites, auras and hands that mend.

entries.name: Paladin (dragonborn)
entries.subject: a gold-scaled dragonborn knight in gleaming armour with a radiant shield. A paladin — An oath made steel — smites, auras and hands that mend.

entries.name: Paladin (dwarf)
entries.subject: a dwarf paladin with a white beard, a warhammer and a sun-emblazoned shield. A paladin — An oath made steel — smites, auras and hands that mend.

entries.name: Paladin (goliath)
entries.subject: a goliath paladin with a halo of light and a great holy blade. A paladin — An oath made steel — smites, auras and hands that mend.

entries.name: Ranger (elf)
entries.subject: a hooded elf archer with a longbow, green cloak and keen eyes. A ranger — Tracker and archer who marks a quarry and never lets it go.

entries.name: Ranger (human)
entries.subject: a rugged human man with a three-day beard, a wolf-pelt mantle and a quiver. A ranger — Tracker and archer who marks a quarry and never lets it go.

entries.name: Ranger (halfling)
entries.subject: a halfling woman scout with a hawk on her arm and a shortbow. A ranger — Tracker and archer who marks a quarry and never lets it go.

entries.name: Ranger (orc)
entries.subject: an orc tracker with a scarred face, a recurve bow and bone fetishes. A ranger — Tracker and archer who marks a quarry and never lets it go.

entries.name: Sorcerer (human)
entries.subject: a young human man with ember-orange eyes and flames curling from his fingertips. A sorcerer — Raw magic in the blood; bends spells — and dice — at will.

entries.name: Sorcerer (dragonborn)
entries.subject: a red-scaled dragonborn woman wreathed in draconic fire. A sorcerer — Raw magic in the blood; bends spells — and dice — at will.

entries.name: Sorcerer (tiefling)
entries.subject: a tiefling with glowing magma veins and a confident smirk. A sorcerer — Raw magic in the blood; bends spells — and dice — at will.

entries.name: Sorcerer (elf)
entries.subject: an elf woman with hair of living flame and gold draconic scales on her cheeks. A sorcerer — Raw magic in the blood; bends spells — and dice — at will.

entries.name: Warlock (tiefling)
entries.subject: a tiefling man in a black coat with an infernal contract and violet hellfire. A warlock — A bargain with a fiend: few spells, short rests, terrible power.

entries.name: Warlock (human)
entries.subject: a pale human woman with a raven-feather collar and shadowy eldritch power. A warlock — A bargain with a fiend: few spells, short rests, terrible power.

entries.name: Warlock (elf)
entries.subject: a drow-like dark elf with white hair and a pact blade of purple flame. A warlock — A bargain with a fiend: few spells, short rests, terrible power.

entries.name: Warlock (gnome)
entries.subject: a gnome with an unsettling grin and a glowing fiendish tome. A warlock — A bargain with a fiend: few spells, short rests, terrible power.

entries.name: Wizard (human)
entries.subject: an old human wizard with a long grey beard, a starry blue robe and a crystal staff. A wizard — A scholar of the arcane with the largest spellbook in the Keep.

entries.name: Wizard (gnome)
entries.subject: a gnome woman wizard with goggles, scrolls tucked everywhere and arcane sparks. A wizard — A scholar of the arcane with the largest spellbook in the Keep.

entries.name: Wizard (elf)
entries.subject: a high elf woman with a circlet, an open spellbook and floating glyphs. A wizard — A scholar of the arcane with the largest spellbook in the Keep.

entries.name: Wizard (tiefling)
entries.subject: a scholarly tiefling man with spectacles on his horns and a quill of light. A wizard — A scholar of the arcane with the largest spellbook in the Keep.

entries.name: Soot Goblin
entries.subject: a wiry soot-blackened goblin miner with a jagged knife, ember-lit eyes and a sack of stolen dice. Quick hands, sooty grins, and a nose for your dice.

entries.name: Ember Imp
entries.subject: a tiny winged fire imp made of glowing coals, cackling, flinging a bolt of flame. A cackling spark with a grudge against good fortune.

entries.name: Slag Hound
entries.subject: a hulking hound with a hide of cracked cooling slag and magma glowing through the cracks, jaws dripping molten metal. Its hide is cooling slag; its bite is not.

entries.name: Forge Automaton
entries.subject: a squat iron forge automaton with a furnace belly, riveted plates and anvil fists. Built to guard the forge long after the smiths were gone.

entries.name: Ash Cultist
entries.subject: a hooded ash-grey cultist with a smouldering censer and soot-painted face. Robed in grey, chanting to a furnace god.

entries.name: Magma Ooze
entries.subject: a glistening blob of bright orange magma with half-melted weapons floating inside. It remembers being a mountain.

entries.name: The Forgemaster
entries.subject: a towering black-iron forge golem with a furnace chest, a giant hammer, chains and bellows, molten light pouring from its seams. A colossal smith-engine that still keeps the forge lit. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: Ash Hydra
entries.subject: a five-headed hydra of charcoal scales and glowing ember throats rising from an ash pit. Every head you cut grows back hotter. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Bound Ember
entries.subject: a blazing fire elemental bound by glowing runic chains, a white-hot core and a crown of flame. A fire elemental chained beneath the vaults for an age. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: Sporeling
entries.subject: a waddling knee-high mushroom creature with a spotted cap, puffing a cloud of glowing spores. Waddling mushrooms with a toxic sneeze.

entries.name: Moss Wight
entries.subject: an undead knight overgrown with moss and roots, hollow green-glowing eyes and a rusted blade. A mausoleum knight wrapped in moss and grave-roots.

entries.name: Thorn Sprite
entries.subject: a tiny malicious fey sprite with bramble wings and a bow of thorns, glowing pink. Giggling fey that think your luck is their toy.

entries.name: Vine Strangler
entries.subject: a writhing mass of thick strangling vines with a gaping flower maw at its centre. The hallway is alive, and it wants to hug you.

entries.name: Fungal Shaman
entries.subject: a tall stooped fungus-folk shaman with a glowing mushroom-capped staff and robes of lichen. A myconid elder whose staff blooms with healing caps.

entries.name: Bark Golem
entries.subject: a massive golem of living oak bark and roots, moss beard, glowing amber sap eyes. Old oak shaped into a guardian by forgotten druids.

entries.name: The Mycelial Monarch
entries.subject: a colossal regal fungus monarch on a throne of mushrooms, a crown of glowing caps and a veil of drifting spores. A fungal intelligence that rules the halls from a throne of caps. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Thorn Knight
entries.subject: a fey knight in armour grown from thorny briars and roses, wielding a briar lance. A fey knight sworn to keep the dead asleep. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Root Dragon
entries.subject: a great dragon whose body is twisted roots and bark, with moss wings and glowing green rot breath. An ancient wyrm that became more tree than dragon. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: Ink Eel
entries.subject: a sinuous black eel with glowing glyph markings, trailing clouds of ink through water. It swims through the drowned stacks in clouds of black ink.

entries.name: Drowned Scribe
entries.subject: a bloated drowned undead scribe in waterlogged robes with a glowing quill and dripping scrolls. Still copying the same page it drowned writing.

entries.name: Brass Crab
entries.subject: a large clockwork crab of verdigris brass with gears, barnacles and lamp eyes. A clockwork librarian's guard, barnacled and furious.

entries.name: Tide Cultist
entries.subject: a scaled tide cultist with a coral trident, eel-skin robes and a conch. Eel-cult priests who sing to the inverted tide.

entries.name: Glyph Wisp
entries.subject: a floating crackling ball of blue lightning shaped like a glowing rune. A loose letter of power, crackling between the shelves.

entries.name: Deep Lurker
entries.subject: a hulking anglerfish-like lurker with tentacles and a lantern lure, teeth like broken pens. Something with too many arms lives in the reading pool.

entries.name: The Drowned Archivist
entries.subject: a towering drowned lich-librarian with a hood of floating pages, chained tomes and a lantern of drowned starlight. It has catalogued every death in the archive. Yours is next. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Tide Oracle
entries.subject: a blindfolded sea oracle with a fishtail of glowing scales, floating in an upward-falling column of water. A sea-witch who sees futures in reversed tides. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Armored Leviathan
entries.subject: an enormous armored leviathan encased in brass plating and pistons, barnacled, porthole eyes glowing. A great beast caged in brass to drive the archive's pumps. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: Shard Stalker
entries.subject: a lean predator made of jagged mirror shards, reflecting distorted faces. A predator of broken glass that moves between reflections.

entries.name: Mirror Mimic
entries.subject: an ornate standing mirror whose frame is splitting into a toothy maw with a long tongue. It looks like you. Then it opens its mouth.

entries.name: Prism Wisp
entries.subject: a small floating triangular glass prism with no body, no legs and no animal shape, a bright spark of light burning at its core, fanning sharp rainbow beams out of its faces, tiny glass shards orbiting it like moths. Light, split and angry.

entries.name: Glass Golem
entries.subject: a hulking golem made of stained-glass panels with lead seams and a glowing rose window chest. A cathedral window that got up and walked.

entries.name: Facet Cultist
entries.subject: a masked cultist with a faceted mirror mask and robes sewn with glass beads. Worshippers of the perfect reflection.

entries.name: Hollow Double
entries.subject: a faceless humanoid made of dark mirror glass, holding a mirror-image sword. Your reflection, hungry and hollow.

entries.name: The Prism Sentinel
entries.subject: a towering crystal knight sentinel of faceted prisms with a halberd of light, rainbow refractions everywhere. The reliquary's last guardian, built of a thousand lenses. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Shattered Double
entries.subject: a fractured mirror-glass doppelganger warrior with shards orbiting it, cracks of white light across its body. Everything the mirrors ever stole, wearing your face. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Glass Seraph
entries.subject: a six-winged seraph made of stained glass with a cracked golden halo, radiant and serene. An angel of stained glass with a cracked halo. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: Grave Sentinel
entries.subject: a tall skeletal sentinel in star-etched armour holding a bone glaive, a nebula glowing in its ribcage. Skeletal guardians of the floating tombs.

entries.name: Void Mote
entries.subject: a floating orb of absolute black ringed with violet event-horizon light. A pinprick of nothing that eats light.

entries.name: Starbone Hound
entries.subject: a skeletal hound whose bones are linked by glowing constellation lines, star-fire eyes. A hound of constellations, held together by old light.

entries.name: Comet Cultist
entries.subject: a robed comet cultist with a meteorite staff trailing fire and a star-map cloak. They pray for the sky to fall again.

entries.name: Astral Leech
entries.subject: a translucent cosmic leech with a ring of teeth and swirling galaxy innards. It feeds on luck, then on blood.

entries.name: Orbit Warden
entries.subject: a floating brass orrery construct with rotating rings and glowing planet orbs. A brass orrery that commands gravity.

entries.name: The Astral Judge
entries.subject: a colossal judge seated on a floating throne of meteorite stone, its deep hood empty except for a single blazing white star where the face should be, flowing robes of living night sky, holding up enormous golden balance scales whose two pans each cradle a tiny glowing planet; no skull, no armour, no staff. It weighs every soul that falls from the sky. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Fallen Comet
entries.subject: a living molten comet with a rocky face and a long blazing tail, crater-scarred. A star that fell and did not die. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Epoch Devourer
entries.subject: a vast cosmic serpent-worm of void with clock-faces dissolving in its maw and nebula-filled eyes. It ate the civilisation that built the ossuary. It is still hungry. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: Cinder Giant
entries.subject: a hulking giant with skin like cooling basalt, magma veins, a soot beard and an enormous furnace-iron maul. The forge-tenders the smiths were afraid of.

entries.name: Pyre Drake
entries.subject: a lean wingspread fire drake with ember-red scales, smoke curling from its nostrils, perched on a chain over a forge. A lean drake that nests in the bellows and breathes the forge's heat.

entries.name: Blight Treant
entries.subject: a towering rotting treant with grey blighted bark, glowing fungal growths and roots tearing up the flagstones. A rotting oak-warden that still remembers its oath.

entries.name: Briar Hag
entries.subject: a stooped fey hag with bark-like skin, a cloak of brambles and roses, long thorn fingers and one glowing green eye. She trades in luck and pays in thorns.

entries.name: Kraken Spawn
entries.subject: a young kraken with a beaked maw and a dozen barnacled tentacles bursting up through flooded library shelves. Young, hungry, and already too big for the reading pool.

entries.name: Sunken Lich
entries.subject: a skeletal lich crowned with coral and kelp, levitating cross-legged inside a floating sphere of clear seawater, long drifting drowned hair, a glowing sea-glass phylactery on a chain at its ribs, bony hands weaving a small whirlpool; bare-headed, no hood, no lantern, no books or paper. A scholar who chose the water over forgetting.

entries.name: Mirror Knight
entries.subject: a tall knight of polished mirror-plate with no one inside, its silvered greatsword reflecting the viewer. Armour polished so long it forgot there was a knight inside.

entries.name: Facet Archon
entries.subject: a floating wingless celestial shaped like a huge cut diamond, a calm serene mask-face set into its central facet, four slender crystal arms holding shards of prismatic light, rings of rainbow light orbiting it; abstract and geometric, not a woman, no feathers, no halo. An angel of the reliquary, cut like a jewel.

entries.name: Nebula Wraith
entries.subject: a faceless drifting wraith made of swirling violet and pink nebula gas, an old cracked brass telescope eyepiece glowing where its face should be, a long tail of stardust instead of legs, reaching forward with long shadow claws; no skull, no hood, no robe. A dead astronomer, now mostly the dark between stars.

entries.name: Starwyrm
entries.subject: a long serpentine dragon with deep-blue scales dusted with constellations and a mane of trailing comet-light. A serpent that coils in orbit and breathes falling stars.

entries.name: Tiamat
entries.subject: Tiamat, a colossal five-headed chromatic dragon queen with red, blue, green, black and white heads, coiled atop a mountain of gold coins and dice, wings spread. The five-headed Dragon Queen, sealed behind the Sixth Door for an age, and awake again. It is a towering BOSS: monumental, imposing, filling the frame.

entries.name: Copper Tooth
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Copper Tooth". Its power: +3 Mult.

entries.name: Twin Fang
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Twin Fang". Its power: +5 Mult if the hand contains a Pair.

entries.name: Triple Crown
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Triple Crown". Its power: +8 Mult if the hand contains Three of a Kind.

entries.name: Ladder of Bones
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Ladder of Bones". Its power: +8 Mult if the hand contains a Straight.

entries.name: Guildmark
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Guildmark". Its power: +7 Mult if the hand contains a Set.

entries.name: Pebble Pouch
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Pebble Pouch". Its power: +16 Chips if the hand contains Two Pair.

entries.name: Odd Fellow's Coin
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Odd Fellow's Coin". Its power: Scored odd dice give +2 Mult.

entries.name: Even Keel
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Even Keel". Its power: Scored even dice give +4 Chips.

entries.name: Snake-Eye Locket
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Snake-Eye Locket". Its power: Scored 1s give +5 Mult.

entries.name: Hexagon Spur
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Hexagon Spur". Its power: Scored 6s give +6 Chips and +1 Mult.

entries.name: Whetstone
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Whetstone". Its power: +20 Chips if 3 or fewer dice are played.

entries.name: Gambler's Grin
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Gambler's Grin". Its power: +3 Mult per unused reroll (up to +9).

entries.name: Last Laugh
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Last Laugh". Its power: +10 Mult if the acting hero is below half HP.

entries.name: Rusted Key
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Rusted Key". Its power: Earn 2 doubloons after each combat.

entries.name: Kinship Band
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Kinship Band". Its power: Scored dice matching the hero's affinity give +1 extra Mult.

entries.name: Lantern Moth
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Lantern Moth". Its power: +12 Chips on spells.

entries.name: Brawler's Knuckle
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Brawler's Knuckle". Its power: +4 Mult on weapon attacks.

entries.name: Bloodstone
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Bloodstone". Its power: Gains +1 Mult whenever an enemy dies.

entries.name: Dragon's Ledger
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Dragon's Ledger". Its power: +1 Mult for every 3 doubloons you hold.

entries.name: Loaded Knucklebone
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Loaded Knucklebone". Its power: +1 reroll every turn.

entries.name: Deep Pockets
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Deep Pockets". Its power: +1 tray size.

entries.name: Crooked Ladder
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Crooked Ladder". Its power: Straights and Sets can be made with 4 dice.

entries.name: Gap-Tooth Grin
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Gap-Tooth Grin". Its power: Straights may skip one number.

entries.name: Weighted Fate
entries.subject: a heavy grey lead die hanging from a silver chain, one corner drilled and plugged with a bead of blue enamel, a small silver weight swinging beneath it

entries.name: Butcher's Hook
entries.subject: a small heavy iron butcher's meat hook charm, dark and notched along its curve, hung from a short loop of chain with a red thread wound at the top

entries.name: Hawk's Monocle
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Hawk's Monocle". Its power: Critical hits on one lower d20 face.

entries.name: Stoic Shield
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Stoic Shield". Its power: Guard grants double Ward.

entries.name: Mender's Thread
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Mender's Thread". Its power: Healing is 50% stronger.

entries.name: Lucky Seven
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Lucky Seven". Its power: ×3 Mult if scored pips total a multiple of 7.

entries.name: Rolling Snowball
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Rolling Snowball". Its power: Gains +3 Chips each time a Pair is played.

entries.name: Iron Piggy
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Iron Piggy". Its power: Interest cap +5.

entries.name: Parity Seal
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Parity Seal". Its power: ×1.5 Mult if all scored dice are odd, or all even.

entries.name: Magpie Nest
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Magpie Nest". Its power: Scored Gold dice give +2 more doubloons.

entries.name: Echo Bell
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Echo Bell". Its power: The first scored die triggers twice.

entries.name: Sixfold Bell
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Sixfold Bell". Its power: Scored 6s trigger twice.

entries.name: Sandglass
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Sandglass". Its power: ×2 Mult on the first hand of each combat.

entries.name: Quarry Sigil
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Quarry Sigil". Its power: ×1.5 Mult against a Marked or Hexed target.

entries.name: Pocket Sun
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Pocket Sun". Its power: +3 Mult per scored Sun or Ember die.

entries.name: Night Owl
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Night Owl". Its power: +3 Mult per scored Shadow or Arcane die.

entries.name: Iron Root
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Iron Root". Its power: +3 Mult per scored Steel, Verdant, Storm or Blood die.

entries.name: Bone Dust
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Bone Dust". Its power: Scored Bone dice give +10 Chips.

entries.name: Tyrant's Crown
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Tyrant's Crown". Its power: ×2 Mult on Four of a Kind or better.

entries.name: Twin Suns
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Twin Suns". Its power: ×2 Mult if the hand contains Two Pair.

entries.name: Glass Heart
entries.subject: a heart-shaped charm blown from clear, fragile glass, hollow and transparent with a faint pink glow inside and a hairline crack, hung on a thin gold chain

entries.name: Ouroboros Ring
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Ouroboros Ring". Its power: Gains ×0.1 Mult per hand played this run.

entries.name: Wheel of Chance
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Wheel of Chance". Its power: 1 in 3 chance for ×3 Mult.

entries.name: Pauper's Crown
entries.subject: a tiny shabby crown made of dented tin and knotted twine, with chipped coloured-glass "jewels", hung on a frayed cord: a beggar-king's crown that is somehow precious

entries.name: Monolith
entries.subject: a tiny standing stone of dark granite, a single tall monolith with faint glowing carved bands and no markings that read as numbers, hung from a gold ring

entries.name: Prismatic Lens
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Prismatic Lens". Its power: Every die counts as every material.

entries.name: Mimic Tongue
entries.subject: a magical trinket charm called "Mimic Tongue". Its power: Copies the charm to its right.

entries.subject: a dry archive alcove above the floodwater: an open brass-bound chest of gold, scroll cases and pearls on a stone shelf, ripples of teal light

entries.name: The Drowned Archive — elite
entries.subject: a flooded circular reading room with a huge broken chandelier half-sunk in black water, shelves leaning inward, cold menacing light from below

entries.name: The Drowned Archive — arena2
entries.subject: a shallow flooded atrium with drowned reading desks, pillars and a long stone balcony, still water reflecting a glass ceiling

entries.name: The Drowned Archive — entrance
entries.subject: the grand stair of a sunken library descending into still teal water between toppled columns

entries.name: The Drowned Archive — camp
entries.subject: a dry reading nook on a balcony above flooded stacks, a small oil lamp and folded blankets

entries.name: The Drowned Archive — shrine
entries.subject: a small flooded chapel of the archivists with a stone lectern and candles floating on the water

entries.name: The Drowned Archive — peddler
entries.subject: a merchant's rowing boat moored among floating bookshelves, lanterns and crates aboard

entries.name: The Drowned Archive — corridor2
entries.subject: a narrow aisle between towering flooded bookshelves, light rippling across the spines

entries.name: The Drowned Archive — corridor3
entries.subject: a brass-piped passage with a soft waterfall of loose pages pouring from a broken ceiling

entries.name: The Mirror Reliquary — treasure
entries.subject: a glass reliquary: a crystal chest overflowing with gold and prismatic gems on a pedestal, reflected endlessly in surrounding mirrors

entries.name: The Mirror Reliquary — elite
entries.subject: a dusky twilight hall of tall smoky grey-violet mirrors, softly painted, lit mainly by a cold violet glow spilling from one huge cracked mirror at the far end, shards of broken glass scattered across the floor, an uneasy hushed mood but still clearly visible

entries.name: The Mirror Reliquary — arena2
entries.subject: a sunlit glass cloister with tall stained-glass panes casting coloured light across an open marble floor, a few shattered panes

entries.name: The Mirror Reliquary — entrance
entries.subject: a pale crystalline portal in a ruined cloister, daylight refracting into soft rainbows

entries.name: The Mirror Reliquary — camp
entries.subject: a quiet alcove in a glass cathedral, a small campfire reflected endlessly in the mirrored walls

entries.name: The Mirror Reliquary — shrine
entries.subject: a slender white altar holding a floating crystal, petals of light drifting down

entries.name: The Mirror Reliquary — peddler
entries.subject: a merchant's stall of hanging mirrors and lenses in a glass gallery

entries.name: The Mirror Reliquary — corridor2
entries.subject: a hall of tall arched mirrors reflecting a sunlit meadow that is not there

entries.name: The Mirror Reliquary — corridor3
entries.subject: a spiral staircase of stained glass rising into white light

entries.name: The Starfall Ossuary — treasure
entries.subject: a meteorite hoard on a drifting rock: an open star-iron chest of gold and glowing star fragments under a dense field of stars

entries.name: The Starfall Ossuary — elite
entries.subject: a broken ring-shaped platform floating in the void, a huge cracked dark star looming behind it, shards of bone and rock orbiting, ominous light

entries.name: The Starfall Ossuary — arena2
entries.subject: a wide floating plaza of pale stone tiles adrift among clouds, broken columns and a soft violet nebula overhead

entries.name: The Starfall Ossuary — entrance
entries.subject: a ruined stone archway on a floating island at the edge of a starfield, a path of drifting stepping stones

entries.name: The Starfall Ossuary — camp
entries.subject: a small campfire on a floating island of gravestones beneath a vast sky of stars and aurora

entries.name: The Starfall Ossuary — shrine
entries.subject: a lonely observatory shrine with a brass astrolabe and a meteorite altar

entries.name: The Starfall Ossuary — peddler
entries.subject: a merchant's cart chained to a drifting rock, star maps and lanterns swaying

entries.name: The Starfall Ossuary — corridor2
entries.subject: a narrow bridge of bone and starlight arcing over a sea of clouds

entries.name: The Starfall Ossuary — corridor3
entries.subject: a cloister of floating tombs orbiting a dim dead star, constellations traced in light

entries.name: A Locked Chest
entries.subject: A Locked Chest. An iron-banded chest squats in an alcove. The lock is old but stubborn, and there are scratches around the keyhole — someone tried before you.

entries.name: A Wounded Adventurer
entries.subject: A Wounded Adventurer. A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with short grey-streaked hair, in a rival guild's red-and-gold tabard, slumps against a dungeon wall clutching a wound; beside her an empty, torn dice pouch lies open on the floor.

entries.name: The Dicing Ghost
entries.subject: The Dicing Ghost. The translucent ghost of an old riverboat gambler, a stout grey-whiskered man in a tattered frock coat and battered hat, sits at a table of bone in a candlelit vault, grinning as he rattles a dice cup.

entries.name: The Wheel of Fate
entries.subject: The Wheel of Fate. A great wheel of brass and bone stands in the centre of the room, studded with pictures: a crown, a skull, a coin, a die. A slot waits for a coin.

entries.name: Altar of Offerings
entries.subject: Altar of Offerings. Carved into the altar: a hand releasing a die. Below, a bowl worn smooth by countless sacrifices.

entries.name: Collapsed Passage
entries.subject: Collapsed Passage. Rubble chokes the way. Beyond it you glimpse the glint of something valuable.

entries.name: A Bubbling Cauldron
entries.subject: A Bubbling Cauldron. An abandoned alchemist's camp. A cauldron still simmers with something purple and smug.

entries.name: Pressure Plates
entries.subject: Pressure Plates. An empty stone hall whose floor is a chessboard of square pressure plates, rows of small dark dart holes in both walls, a few old darts and a dropped lantern on the tiles. No people.

entries.name: A Rival Party
entries.subject: A Rival Party. Three adventurers from the Copper Lantern guild block the corridor. "This dungeon's ours. Pay the toll or turn around."

entries.name: Forgotten Shrine
entries.subject: Forgotten Shrine. A small shrine to a god of travellers. Candle stubs. A cracked offering bowl.

entries.name: The Grinning Idol
entries.subject: The Grinning Idol. A small golden idol grins on a pedestal. It practically begs to be taken. The room is suspiciously clean.

entries.name: The Boss Sigil
entries.subject: The Boss Sigil. A sigil-key rests on a plinth, humming. Wards flicker around it.

entries.name: Mechanism
entries.subject: Mechanism. A lever, worn smooth by many hands.

entries.name: Valve Chamber
entries.subject: Valve Chamber. Pipes hiss. A great wheel-valve could vent the heat — or blow the room apart.

entries.name: The Abandoned Foundry
entries.subject: The Abandoned Foundry. Moulds for weapons line the walls. The crucible is still hot.

entries.name: The Whispering Tree
entries.subject: The Whispering Tree. An ancient tree grows through the crypt roof. Its leaves whisper names of the dead.

entries.name: Sealed Sarcophagus
entries.subject: Sealed Sarcophagus. Roots have cracked the lid. Something inside is wrapped in golden thread.

entries.name: The Ciphered Door
entries.subject: The Ciphered Door. Three rings of glyphs turn on a bronze door. A riddle is etched above: "I am read but never written."

entries.name: Drowned Observatory
entries.subject: Drowned Observatory. A telescope pokes up through the water, aimed at a ceiling painted with stars.

entries.name: The Talking Mirror
entries.subject: The Talking Mirror. A tall ornate standing mirror in an empty glass cathedral; its surface ripples like water and glows softly, as if about to speak. Nobody stands before it.

entries.name: The Confessional
entries.subject: The Confessional. An empty confessional booth made of black glass standing alone in a white crystal cathedral, a faint violet light glowing behind its lattice, its little door ajar. Nobody inside or nearby.

entries.name: The Weighing Scales
entries.subject: The Weighing Scales. Golden scales float in the void. One pan holds a feather. The other waits for you.

entries.name: A Sleeping Star
entries.subject: A Sleeping Star. A star the size of a fist hovers here, dimly pulsing, fast asleep.

entries.name: prologue
entries.subject: a hilltop town at dusk with a great lantern tower; far below in the cliff an ancient stone door with five faintly glowing seals; the faint shape of a five-headed dragon in the clouds

entries.name: cinder
entries.subject: a vast dwarven forge hall going cold, ash drifting up through a broken roof into a pale sky, a single lantern lit on a distant hill

entries.name: rootbound
entries.subject: the giant hollow heart-tree of a forest necropolis withering, its spores dissolving into motes of light

entries.name: drowned
entries.subject: a drained archive vault, an old chart of a great stone door spread on a table, puddles reflecting the sky

entries.name: mirror
entries.subject: a shattered cathedral of mirrors, shards floating in the air, a white dragon's reflection fading from the glass

entries.name: retreat
entries.subject: a winding road at dusk leading back to a small hilltop keep with warm lit windows, a dropped lantern and scattered dice beside the road, nobody in sight

entries.name: wipe
entries.subject: an empty dungeon hall at night, a single guttering lantern on the stone floor beside a broken shield and spilled dice, dust in a shaft of pale light, nobody in sight

entries.name: starfall
entries.subject: the fifth lantern flaring on a hilltop keep's tower beneath a sky of falling stars

entries.name: finale
entries.subject: beyond a colossal opened stone door, a mountain of treasure and the vast silhouette of a five-headed dragon, three tiny adventurers seen from behind

entries.name: epilogue
entries.subject: a peaceful hilltop town at dawn with five lanterns burning, flower fields, travellers setting out on a long road

entries.name: keep
entries.subject: the Lantern Keep: a fortified hilltop town at dusk with a great lantern tower, and in the cliff below it, a mysterious ancient stone door with five carved seals glowing

entries.name: guild
entries.subject: a warm adventurers' guild hall interior with a notice board, banners, a roaring hearth and tables of heroes

entries.name: armory
entries.subject: a blacksmith's armory with racks of swords, shields and armour, a glowing forge in back

entries.name: apothecary
entries.subject: a cosy apothecary shop with shelves of glowing potion bottles, dried herbs and a cauldron

entries.name: enchanter
entries.subject: an enchanter's tower study with runes floating in the air over an anvil of crystal

entries.name: training
entries.subject: an outdoor training yard with practice dummies, an archery range and sparring ring at sunset

entries.name: cartographer
entries.subject: a cartographer's map room with a huge table map, compasses, candles and five glowing doorways painted on the wall

entries.name: vault
entries.subject: an underground bank vault with heavy iron doors, chests of gold and guarded lockboxes

entries.name: door
entries.subject: the Sixth Door: a colossal ancient stone door in a cavern, five glowing seals (one for each lesser door), dice-shaped runes, light spilling through the crack
